snapshot: V4 first rendered evaluation set, copied from /workspace/v4_render_first before shader iteration
scope: Independent first-pass visual review only; does not certify current later V4 outputs
method: Inspected all 24 actual PNGs in native64, nearest4x, and V3/V4 native64 boards against actual Golden40 native64 and nearest3x. No numerical visual scores assigned.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Rolled edges and a bean pictogram improve recognition.
items.remaining_defect: Lid center is so dark it reads as an open hole despite the sealed-tin brief; large wrapper stripes are flat.
items.recommended_correction: Render a continuous closed lid with an inset seam or pull-tab cue; tighten wrapper curvature and preserve compact metal glints.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Different short/wide can proportions and pea motif replace simple recoloring.
items.remaining_defect: Dark inset again suggests an open can; bright left wrapper wedge and flat right half do not look like paper around a cylinder.
items.recommended_correction: Keep a closed steel lid and use a broader matte wrapper ramp distinct from the thin steel rim.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Asymmetric lobed silhouette and stem recess are meaningful improvements.
items.remaining_defect: Hard diagonal red bands dominate the body, while stem well and small skin marks are noisy relative to the broad unmodeled right side.
items.recommended_correction: Group the highlight into a curved upper-left lobe, shade the lower recess and refine the silhouette with a few connected clusters.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: The narrow curved neck and weighty lower body identify a pear.
items.remaining_defect: The generated fruit is orange-brown, contradicting the yellow-green recipe. Broad diagonal shading makes it resemble carved wood or a gourd.
items.recommended_correction: Fix hue transformation before detail work; render a muted yellow-green rind with coherent curved volume.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Lid seam, latches and handle improve assembly.
items.remaining_defect: Brown case with a pale sign loses the medical off-white/red color language; wide top/front faces remain flat and the handle vanishes on a dark background.
items.recommended_correction: Use a deliberate medical colorway, molded corner thickness and attachment occlusion; improve handle/body contrast.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Folded lid edge is clearer than V3.
items.remaining_defect: Looks like a generic brown carton with a stripe and tiny dashes; no readily understood dressing motif, and bottom plane remains unmodulated.
items.recommended_correction: Draw a larger independent bandage pictogram with pad/perforation cues; keep matte folded paper edges.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Curved claw, head thickness and shaped wooden handle give a more believable tool.
items.remaining_defect: Claw still reads as one broad curved hook rather than two prongs; handle/head contact lacks a clear eye or wedged socket.
items.recommended_correction: Separate the claw tips with negative space and add a compact shaded eye/haft junction without enlarging the head.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: The round peen and shaped handle distinguish it from the claw hammer.
items.remaining_defect: Peen resembles a vertical disk, with no neck or spherical mass; forging and handle socket remain schematic.
items.recommended_correction: Reduce the peen to a properly connected rounded ball and neck; shade its dome with compact localized highlights.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Fluted grip, collar and longer shaft improve construction.
items.remaining_defect: Amber grip renders muddy olive-brown; tip remains a near-identical small diamond to the Phillips, weak at 32px.
items.recommended_correction: Fix the amber hue, establish a clearly flattened blade shoulder and separate grip flutes with broader molded shading.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Ribbed grip and collar improve assembly.
items.remaining_defect: Cross-tip distinction remains only a few scattered pixels and is not reliably legible at inventory scale. Grip uses the same straight slab feel as the flathead.
items.recommended_correction: Design a compact tapered cross-facet point with a different silhouette; keep grip shading soft rather than metallic.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Worm region, thicker head and hanging-hole location are improvements.
items.remaining_defect: Jaw tips are curved prongs with weak straight gripping faces; the hanging hole is filled dark rather than cut out.
items.recommended_correction: Use opposing straight jaw faces and a readable movable slide; cut an actual transparent hanging hole and shade its rim.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Dedicated red frame, teeth and adjustment collar separate it from the adjustable wrench.
items.remaining_defect: Hook/frame spacing and toothed jaw relationship are still mechanically ambiguous; handle hole is painted dark instead of transparent.
items.recommended_correction: Clarify which jaw moves along the shank, add two opposing grip faces and open the handle hole.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Directional grain and end face are clearer.
items.remaining_defect: Parallel dark streaks repeat evenly like decorative grooves; broad top is one flat tan face and worn edges lack localized logic.
items.recommended_correction: Use fewer broken grain runs with a subdued knot, darker end grain and a restrained light edge.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Dark end and side plus bright edge are an improvement.
items.remaining_defect: Very broad pale uniform face reads like a painted block or plastic; tiny scratches add detail without making steel physically convincing.
items.recommended_correction: Lower the broad face value and concentrate sharp reflections at selected bevels and facet transitions.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: An oblique wall, core rim and attached tail replace the puck silhouette.
items.remaining_defect: Core reads as a uniform flat black disk rather than a modeled bore wall; wall and tail merge into large dark blocks and wrapped edge rings are weak.
items.recommended_correction: Clarify bore-wall thickness and wound layers; make any unobstructed through-opening transparent, while retaining physically justified inner-wall shadow. Separate the tail overlap.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Multiple turns and an attached loose end are visible.
items.remaining_defect: Uniform progressively smaller stacked ellipses produce a stepped cone or nest, not a plausible utility-rope coil.
items.recommended_correction: Flatten the coil and offset overlapping turns, add a tied crossing/binding and a continuous free end rather than concentric tiers.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Flap, straps, buckles, pocket and side gusset improve identity.
items.remaining_defect: Repeated large diagonal patches look like folded paper; the lower pocket merges into the body, while shoulder straps are thin dark frame-like strokes.
items.recommended_correction: Shade loaded sewn volumes independently, clarify pocket lip/occlusion and give shoulder straps width and continuous attachment.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Wider body, paired handles and reinforced base distinguish it from the rucksack.
items.remaining_defect: Front panel is a dark flat rectangle and straps appear pasted on; handles lack clear anchors and sewn fabric sag.
items.recommended_correction: Add a loaded bag volume, end gusset seam, handle mount patches and a shallow zipper/closure recess.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Palm mass, cuffs and finger seams improve substantially on the comb-shaped V3.
items.remaining_defect: Both gloves put the thumb on the same right side, producing a same-handed pair. Finger group anatomy is still stiff and pointed.
items.recommended_correction: Mirror one glove, verify an opposed left/right thumb pair, and round the grouped fingertips with knuckle/palm volume.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Folded ribbed brim and crown seam are much clearer.
items.remaining_defect: The navy recipe renders green; broad dark diagonal crown wedge resembles a rigid folded panel rather than soft knit.
items.recommended_correction: Fix the navy hue and use broad soft crown volume with curved seam/rib flow and compact fold occlusion.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Buttons, display, grille and top control establish more functional construction.
items.remaining_defect: Top plane is oversized and almost flat; antenna is nearly invisible on the dark background, and display/grille lack molded recess thickness.
items.recommended_correction: Reduce the boxy top emphasis, give antenna a readable lit edge and reinforce bezel/grille depths with selective small highlights.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Reflector/lens ring, knurled barrel and switch are meaningful improvements.
items.remaining_defect: Head is a flat pale faceted block with a small dark ring that reads like a camera lens; barrel highlights are broad and disconnected from recesses.
items.recommended_correction: Clarify a recessed reflector bowl behind glass, reduce the broad white head facet and keep compact metal/rubber distinctions.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Cap, shoulder, fill line and molded ribs improve construction.
items.remaining_defect: The liquid is an opaque rectangular panel pasted on the front; bright left band is too solid and the cap lacks threaded thickness.
items.recommended_correction: Shade translucent container/liquid as one curved volume while preserving fill-line and rim cues; soften the plastic band into deliberate clusters.

items.visible_improvement_over_v3: Rolled rim, inner wall, curved body and true open handle improve it.
items.remaining_defect: Large broad silver stripes look faceted and painted rather than thin metal; handle attachments and base rim remain weak.
items.recommended_correction: Use a narrower localized highlight, darker joined handle sockets and a subtle base lip; retain the correctly transparent handle.
